home.empty: No journals yet. The murloc is waiting by the water.
home.emptyHelp: Play with the Mrglglgl addon installed, then log out or type /reload: the game saves the journal at those moments, and it appears here.
home.noInstall: No World of Warcraft folder was found. Choose it in Settings.
home.pick: Choose a character on the left to read their journal.

sync.explain: The game saves journals only when you log out or type /reload. New entries show up here a few seconds after that.
sync.archivedHelp: This character's game files are gone. Their journal is kept here.

status.older: Saved by an older addon version.
status.newer: Saved by a newer addon version.
status.unreadable: This journal file could not be read. The last readable copy is shown.
status.olderNext: Log in once with the current addon to update it.
status.newerNext: Update the app to read it.
status.unreadableNext: Log in and out once in the game so it saves the file again.

character.removeBody: This deletes the app's copy of this journal: its archive, backups and milestones. The game's own files are not touched, so if the character still exists, their journal is read again next time.
character.compacted: Summary only: the game kept the details for a few days and the app saw only this summary.

week.empty: Nothing written on this page. The murloc checked twice.
week.emptyHelp: Days appear here once you have played them with the addon installed.

page.unnamedKills_one: a creature the journal never learned the name of
page.unnamedKills_other: {{count}} creatures the journal never learned the names of
page.anonKills_one: Also defeated a foe the game kept nameless.
page.anonKills_other: Also defeated {{count}} foes the game kept nameless.

environment.Fatigue: Swam out too far and tired

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.none: No stamps yet. The murloc suggests fishing up a boot.

kept_the_boot.name: Kept the Boot
kept_the_boot.description: Fished up a boot. Kept it.

first_murloc.name: First Blood (Fishy)
first_murloc.description: Slew a murloc for the first time.

only_fished.name: Gone Fishin'
only_fished.description: A whole day of fishing and nothing else.

bad_day.name: Character Building
bad_day.description: Died three times in one day.

tourist.name: Tourist
tourist.description: Discovered five places in one day.

settings.title: Settings
settings.wowFolderHelp: Leave empty to find it automatically. Enter the game folder (the one containing _forever_) or a flavor folder such as _forever_.
settings.foundNone: No World of Warcraft folder found.
settings.backupRetentionHelp: Your journal's full history stays in the app whatever you choose. Backups are only a safety net: copies of the raw files the game saved. Every copy from the last week is kept; older ones are thinned to one a day.
settings.forgetting: Forgetting data in the game (with the addon's "Forget recorded" buttons) changes only the game's files. The app keeps its own copy until you remove the character here.
settings.error: The settings could not be saved: {{message}}
settings.narratorHelp: Who writes your journal. You can pick another narrator for a single day from the day itself.
settings.meddlingHelp: How often the murloc adds a note in the margin. The same day always gets the same answer, even when it is written again.
settings.writeWhilePlaying: Write while the game is running
settings.writeWhilePlayingHelp: Off by default: writing uses the processor, and the game may stutter. When off, writing waits until you close the game.
settings.copyFooter: Add "via Mrglglgl" when copying an entry

provider.local: This computer (a writing model downloaded once)
provider.endpoint: An endpoint you run or pay for (OpenAI-compatible)

settings.endpointUrlHelp: The address ending in /v1, for example http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.
settings.apiKeyHelp: Kept in your system's keychain, never in the app's files.
settings.connectionOk: The endpoint answered and has this model.
settings.disclosure: This address is not on this computer. When writing, the app sends {{host}}: your character's name, the names of people you grouped with, and the text of quests you touched that day, along with what happened that day.
settings.pseudonyms: Send stand-in names for the people you grouped with
settings.pseudonymsHelp: Their real names are put back in the entry when it comes back.
settings.foundNoneNext: Enter the game folder above (the one containing _forever_), then save.
settings.errorNext: Check that the folder above exists, then save again.
settings.connectionFailedNext: Check the address (it usually ends in /v1), that the server is running and the model name, then test again.
settings.writeOnBatteryHelp: Off by default: writing uses the processor hard and drains a laptop. When off, writing waits until the charger is plugged in. Checked on macOS and Windows laptops.
settings.reviewHelp: New entries wait in To review until you accept them. Off: they go straight into the journal.
settings.zoomHelp: Text and layout together, on this computer. ⌘ or Ctrl with + and − change it too; with 0 it goes back to 100%.
settings.paperHelp: How the journal's pages look, on this computer. Exports and PDFs use it too.

backlog.waiting_one: {{count}} entry is waiting to be written.
backlog.waiting_other: {{count}} entries are waiting to be written.
backlog.failed_one: {{count}} entry could not be written; open its day to retry.
backlog.failed_other: {{count}} entries could not be written; open their days to retry.

outcome.timedOut: Stopped: writing took too long. Nothing was saved.
outcome.failed: The murloc could not write this: {{message}}
outcome.cancelledNext: Press Write now when you want this one written.
outcome.timedOutNext: Press Write again to retry, or pick a smaller model in Settings.
outcome.failedNext: It is tried again on its own in a moment; you can also press Write now.

writing.setAside: The murloc's entry was set aside because it {{reason}}.
writing.notYet: The murloc hasn't written this one yet. It is number {{position}} in line.

blocked.noModel: No writing model is downloaded yet.
blocked.noEndpoint: The endpoint is not set up yet.
blocked.gameRunning: Writing waits while the game is running, so the game keeps running smoothly.
blocked.pausedNext: Press Resume writing at the top of this page.
blocked.noModelNext: Download one in Settings, under Writing models.
blocked.noEndpointNext: Enter its address and model in Settings, under Who writes.
blocked.gameRunningNext: Close the game, or allow writing while playing in Settings.
blocked.onBattery: Writing waits while this computer runs on battery.
blocked.onBatteryNext: Plug in the charger, or allow writing on battery in Settings.

stillGoing.day: This day isn't over yet. The murloc writes it once it is.
stillGoing.week: This week isn't over yet. Its chapter is written once it is.

reason.timedOut: Writing took too long and was stopped.
reason.cancelledNext: Press Try again to write it.
reason.timedOutNext: Press Try again, or pick a smaller model in Settings.
reason.otherNext: Press Try again; if it fails again, check who writes in Settings.

writing.setAsideNext: Here is what happened instead. Press Write again for a new attempt.
writing.soFarNote: The day goes on. The full entry is written once the day is over.

models.title: Writing models
models.help: Writing happens on this computer with a model you download once. It is stored in the app's own folder, never inside the game folder.
models.confirmBody: This downloads {{size}} GB from Hugging Face into the app's folder. It happens once; the model is used from there afterwards.
models.notEnoughMemory: This computer has {{has}} GB of memory; the writing models need {{needed}} GB.
models.notEnoughDisk: There is {{free}} GB free on this disk; a writing model needs about {{needed}} GB.
models.failedNext: Check the internet connection and free disk space, then press Resume download: it continues where it stopped.
models.notEnoughMemoryNext: Use an endpoint instead (a model running on another machine or a service): choose it under Who writes, below.
models.notEnoughDiskNext: Free some space and come back, or use an endpoint under Who writes, below.
models.firstRun: To write your journal, the app needs a writing model. {{name}} suits this computer.

share.copyFailedNext: Select the entry's text and copy it with the keyboard instead.
share.exportFailedNext: Pick a folder you can write to, outside the World of Warcraft folder, then export again.

formatHelp.html: One file that opens in any browser, laid out like the journal here: pages, stamps and screenshots. Days the murloc has not written yet show what happened.
formatHelp.pdf: Opens the journal laid out for paper in the print dialog. Choose Save as PDF there (Microsoft Print to PDF on Windows).
formatHelp.markdown: Plain text with headings, for notes apps and wikis. No stamps or pictures.

errors.load: The app could not read its data: {{message}}
errors.loadNext: Restart the app. If it happens again, report it on the project page with this message.

firstRun.title: Getting started
firstRun.modelOffer: When you are ready, the app can download {{name}} ({{size}} GB) to write your journal on this computer. Nothing is downloaded until you choose to.

review.title: To review
review.intro: Finished days and weeks without an entry in the journal, and drafts waiting for you. A draft goes into the journal only when you accept it.
review.empty: Nothing to review. Every finished day has its entry.
review.discarded: You threw the last draft away.
review.replaces: The journal already has an entry here; accepting this draft replaces it.
review.waiting: Waiting to be written, number {{position}} in line.
review.noteHelp: Tone, length or focus, up to 120 characters. The events stay the day's own.
review.notePlaceholder: Shorter, or more about the boot
review.draftsWaiting_one: {{count}} draft is waiting in To review.
review.draftsWaiting_other: {{count}} drafts are waiting in To review.
review.draftWaitingHere: A draft for this day is waiting in To review.

narrators.title: Narrators
narrators.help: The voice entries are written in. Built-in narrators stay as they ship; make your own from a copy of one.
narrators.deleteBody: Entries it wrote keep their text. Writing that used it goes back to the murloc scribe.
narrators.importHelp: A .toml file someone exported from Mrglglgl.
narrators.exportHelp: Saves the narrator as one file you can share or keep.
narrators.name: Name
narrators.personaHelp: Who the narrator is and how they keep the journal. Written to the model, as "You are…".
narrators.voiceHelp: How they sound: sentence length, mood, what they notice.
narrators.exampleEntryHelp: A whole entry in this voice, written from the example notes under More. Small models copy its shape more than anything else.
narrators.murlocHelp: How the murloc may show in an ordinary entry.
narrators.marginNoteHelp: Used on days the murloc gets hold of the pen.
narrators.exampleNotesHelp: The made-up day the example entry is written from.
narrators.hintsHelp: What to make of a day with this pattern. Leave empty to say nothing special.
narrators.fix: Some fields need fixing before this can be saved.

problem.noStar: Start it with * as entries' margin notes do.
problem.unknownHint: The app does not know this kind of day.

narrators.previewHelp: Writes one day with this narrator as it is now, saved or not. Nothing goes into the journal. About a minute on this computer's model.
narrators.previewTimedOut: Writing took too long. Try again, or a smaller model in Settings.
narrators.previewSetAside: The fact check would set this entry aside: {{reason}}
narrators.previewFailed: The preview could not be written: {{message}}
narrators.previewSetAsideNext: Keep the voice and the example to the day's own events, then preview again.
narrators.previewFailedNext: Check that a model is downloaded, or the endpoint is set up, in Settings.
narrators.fileFailedNext: Check the folder or the file, then try again.

export.writtenWith: Written with Mrglglgl, a journal for World of Warcraft adventurers.
export.caption: {{moment}} in {{place}}, {{time}}

labels.written_with: Written with Mrglglgl, a journal for World of Warcraft adventurers.

site.title: Website
site.help: Publish your journals as a blog you can host for free (Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, GitHub Pages): the app writes a finished site into a folder, and you put that folder online.
site.enabled: Keep a website up to date
site.enabledHelp: While the app is open, the folder is rebuilt a few seconds after an entry is accepted or a day changes. Only changed files are rewritten.
site.folderHelp: An empty folder, or one Mrglglgl built. Files it did not make (.git, CNAME) are never touched.
site.addressHelp: Where the site will live, so the feeds can link to it.
site.standInNames: Show other players under stand-in names
site.standInNamesHelp: The people you grouped with did not choose to be on a website. The same stand-in each time, so stories still read naturally.
site.themeFolderHelp: Your own templates and a custom.css; anything missing comes from the default theme. See the theme guide in the project's docs.
site.themeCopied_one: {{count}} theme file copied. Edit them, and keep only the ones you change.
site.themeCopied_other: {{count}} theme files copied. Edit them, and keep only the ones you change.
site.buildFailedNext: Check the site folder and the theme folder, then build again. A template error names its file and line.

addon.title: The addon
addon.noFlavor: No WoW: Forever folder found, so there is no addon to look at yet.

next.notInstalled: The addon is not in {{folder}} yet.
next.waiting: Nothing recorded yet. Log in with a character and the addon starts its journal.
next.quiet: Nothing noted since {{character}} on {{when}}. If you have played since, check that Mrglglgl is enabled in the AddOns list on the character screen.

problem.newerSchema: The installed addon writes a journal newer than this app can read
problem.newerSchemaNext: Update the app; until then, what the addon records waits in the game's files.
problem.updatePending: The game is still running version {{running}}; version {{installed}} is installed
problem.updatePendingNext: Type /reload in the game, or log in again, to load the new version.
problem.outOfDate: The game is newer than the installed addon, so it lists the addon as out of date
problem.outOfDateNext: Update the addon, or tick "Load out of date AddOns" on the character screen.
problem.errors: The addon caught an error on {{when}}: {{message}}
problem.errorsNext: Recording carried on. If it happens again, please report it with this message.

addon.noRelease: No release of the addon was found for this channel.
addon.prereleasesHelp: Test versions come before a release and may still have rough edges. Off, only releases are installed.
addon.takeOver: Replace with version {{version}} and look after it
addon.removeExplain: Only the addon's folder is removed. Everything it recorded stays: in the game's WTF folder and in this app's journal. A copy is kept so you can put it back.

ownership.foreign: Installed by something else (an addon manager or by hand). The app leaves it alone unless you choose to replace it.
ownership.changed: Installed by the app, then changed outside it.
ownership.development: A linked development copy: the app never writes to it.

done.installed: Version {{version}} is installed. Type /reload in the game, or log in, to load it.
done.removed: The addon was removed. Your journals are untouched.

addon.actionFailedNext: The game folder was left as it was. Close the game if it is running, then try again.
addon.releaseFailed: Could not look up the addon's releases: {{message}}
addon.releaseFailedNext: Check the connection, then press Check again; what is installed keeps working.
